newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring up on cold weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring up on cold weather.

text.p: Spring wheat values were mixed Thursday, with some support linked to weather-related transportion difficulties, traders said.

Windy weather has created blowing snowdrifts and subzero temperatures in the Dakotas and Minnesota. Those conditions have virtually halted rail service in some areas and left wheat sellers and buyers without a way to do business, merchandisers said.
"We can't rail out of the Dakotas, mills are starting to get panicky and people are starting to get ornery," said one Minneapolis-based trader.
Dealers in Montana said that temperatures had warmed dramatically Thursday and trains were beginning to run on schedule, although farmers were still having hard time getting their grain to elevators.
In spring wheat export business, Japan bought 40,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat for March shipment, traders said.
